description: Strict Ed25519 verification (S < L, canonical R and A, A not of small order, cofactorless [S]B = R + [k]A). honestSignatureHex verifies under publicKeyHex for messageHex in every verifier. mixedOrderRSignatureHex is valid under ZIP-215's cofactored check (R = rB + T, T of order 8, S = r + k·a) and must be refused by a strict verifier.
